description: Discover the reusable instruments and other developments bundled with this release; look here before building an instrument from module types. Returns stable IDs, exact versions, summaries and importable refs; does not load or play anything. Use schema_version: 1. Limit defaults to 20 (1–100); optional source/id filters and opaque cursor. Copy a ref into describe_development, then developments: [{name: YOUR_ALIAS, ref: RETURNED_REF}] in an invention.

ContentKind.description: Available musical content classification, independent of registered types.

ContentSource.description: Delivery provenance; it never changes package identity.
